In the foreground, there are stage monitors, cables, and the back of an audience member's head. A metal truss system for lighting hangs above the performers.

The figure's anatomy is distorted; the arm holding the guitar neck seems to merge with the instrument body, and the hand structure is undefined/melted.
The drummer's torso and arms blend into the cymbals and drum hardware, lacking clear boundary separation typical of real photography.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the scene is correctly classified as a stage/concert venue and not a generic room or outdoor setting.
To audit the skeletal structure of the human performers, specifically checking for extra limbs or impossible joint angles common in AI generations of crowds/bands.
To verify the 3D spatial relationship between the hanging lights, the performers, and the floor, ensuring the truss doesn't 'melt' into the background.
To check for object fusion between the musical instruments and the players' hands/bodies.

focus_areas: Anatomical correctness of musicians' hands and instruments
Structural integrity of the overhead lighting truss
Boundary sharpness between foreground equipment and the stage floor
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interaction between the musicians and their instruments. AI often fails to render fingers on fretboards or drumsticks correctly. Also, verify if the lighting truss has a consistent vanishing point and structural logic.
